prompt.message.one: Adjust how it fits your monitor?
prompt.message.other: Adjust how it fits your monitors?

hud.hint: Drag to move  ·  Scroll to zoom  ·  Double-click for Fill or Fit  ·  Enter saves  ·  Esc cancels
tip.fill: Cover the screen and crop what does not fit (1)
tip.fit: Show the whole image, with bars where it does not reach (2)
tip.stretch: Fill the screen exactly, changing the image's proportions (3)
tip.actual: One image pixel per screen pixel (4)
tip.rotate: Turn a quarter clockwise; right-click turns it back (R)
tip.everyWallpaper: Use this framing on this monitor, and this image if it has its own, for every wallpaper with nothing saved here. Click again to undo
tip.reset: Back to this monitor's default framing (Backspace)
tip.otherImage: Show a different image on this monitor whenever this wallpaper is set
tip.followWallpaper: Show the wallpaper itself on this monitor again; right-click picks another image instead
overlay.video: This monitor shows the video wallpaper, which the video engine frames. Choose another image to give it a still of its own.
notice.unreadable.title: Wallpaper framing settings can't be read
notice.unreadable.body: %1 has an error, so it is left untouched. Framings you save are kept and written into it once it is fixed.
notice.unwritable.title: Wallpaper framing settings can't be saved
notice.unwritable.body: Couldn't write %1. Your framing stays on screen and is saved with the next change.
